row: A fun and interactive place for learning about cat behavior and great training tips! Kitten School is a loving foster home for cats and kittens to get them ready for their "forever" homes. We will tackle all kinds of cat issues here--from how to tame a fearful cat to gentle solutions for behavioral problems to taking care of sick kitties. And along the way we'll have some tail-chasing, whisker-lickin' fun!
